name: xpaychat
description: XPAY Chat API and static app

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check app.js && node --check admin.js && node --check service-worker.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.android:build: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android && ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./android/gradlew -p android :app:assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android && ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./android/gradlew -p android :app:bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:build && mkdir -p dist && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk dist/XPAYChat-android-html-ui-full.apk
